boundary: Metadata-only synthetic fixtures. Treat model/dataset artifact URIs as opaque references; never open them or invoke external providers.

assertions: prompt/template, tokenizer, chunker, embedding model identifier, dimension and index schema links are source-bound or reported as gaps
dimension, tokenizer revision, prompt hash and retrieval-schema drift are explicit and do not trigger re-indexing or model calls
unversioned remote model identifiers remain observed/requested, not pinned or immutable
dataset/schema/split digest, preprocessing/features, training configuration, artifact reference, evaluation and serving metadata links are represented without opening payloads
train/validation/test role and evaluation provenance are retained only when declared; missing links become gaps
checkpoint URI is never opened, deserialized or executed; no leakage-prevention or model-quality claim is made

verification_boundary: No payload file reads or deserialization, including torch.load, pickle, or joblib load.
No training module/notebook execution, artifact downloads, network calls, provider calls, or LLM invocation.
No persistence, database migration, API, CLI, or UI wiring.
